At some point between [[3681 BBY|3681]] and [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="date" /> during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Leontyne Saresh]] led her fellow slaves in a '''revolt''' against the Empire's forces on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Edusa]]. As a result of the revolt, many slaves were freed, and Saresh went on to become a staunch opponent of the Empire and slavery in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The revolt on Edusa was first mentioned in Leontyne Saresh's bio entry in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
